_comment: Required Content Security Policy for every page in public/. GitLab Pages cannot set custom response headers, so the CSP ships as <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"> in each HTML file. The checker (Phase 3) BLOCKs an MR that removes, or weakens, any directive below.

hsts._comment: HSTS is a response header and cannot be set on *.gitlab.io from the repository. The monitor job records the live Strict-Transport-Security header instead of enforcing it.
